briefdescription.para: Validates user-supplied strings against injection attacks.

detaileddescription.para: Validate User Input.

input
User input to validate
context
Type of validation to apply (SQL, JSON, file, etc.)
ValidationResult with is_valid flag and error details
input
Input parameter.
context
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), validateSqlInjectionRisk(), size(), std::to_string(), validateIdentifier(), validateJsonPayload(), validateUriParameter(), validateSearchQuery().

briefdescription.para: Validates JSON payload structure and size.

detaileddescription.para: Validate Json Payload.

Checks:
Total size < 100MB
Nesting depth < 20 levels
No null bytes in strings
Valid UTF-8 encoding

payload
JSON string to validate
ValidationResult
payload
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: size(), std::to_string(), containsNullBytes(), isValidUtf8().

briefdescription.para: Validates file upload: name, size, MIME type.

detaileddescription.para: Validate File Upload.

Checks:
Filename contains only safe characters [a-zA-Z0-9._-]
No path traversal sequences (../, ..\, etc.)
Extension is whitelisted
Total size < configured maximum (default 500MB)

filename
Original filename from upload
file_size
Size in bytes
mime_type
Content-Type from HTTP header
ValidationResult
filename
Input parameter.
file_size
Input parameter.
mime_type
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: validatePathTraversal(), isalnum(), std::string(), rfind(), ext(), substr(), std::transform(), begin().

briefdescription.para: Validates URI/URL parameters.

detaileddescription.para: Validate Uri Parameter.

Checks:
No control characters (0x00-0x1F, 0x7F)
No null bytes
Valid percent-encoding if present
Length < 8192 bytes

uri_param
Parameter value from URL query string
ValidationResult
uri_param
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: size(), std::to_string(), containsNullBytes(), containsControlCharacters().

briefdescription.para: Validates HTTP request headers.

detaileddescription.para: Validate Request Header.

Checks:
No null bytes
No newline/carriage return (header injection)
Length < 8KB
Valid characters for header values

header_name
Header name (e.g., "User-Agent")
header_value
Header value
ValidationResult
header_name
Name of the header.
header_value
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: size(), std::to_string(), containsNullBytes(), find().

briefdescription.para: Validates search query input.

detaileddescription.para: Validate Search Query.

Checks:
Length between 1-256 characters
No SQL wildcards unless explicitly allowed
No regex control characters unless in regex mode

query
Search string
allow_wildcards
If true, allow * and % wildcards
ValidationResult
query
Input parameter.
allow_wildcards
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), size(), validateSqlInjectionRisk().

HTML-safe string
input

briefdescription.para: Sanitizes string for safe use in SQL (for logging only, not queries!).

detaileddescription.para: Sanitize For Sql Logging.
WARNING: This is for LOGGING ONLY. Never use this for SQL queries! Always use parameterized queries with placeholders (?).
Escapes single quotes and backslashes.

input
String to sanitize
SQL-safe string (for logging)
input
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: reserve(), size().

briefdescription.para: Sanitizes string for safe use in shell commands (not recommended!).

detaileddescription.para: Sanitize For Shell.
WARNING: Avoid executing shell commands with user input. Prefer native APIs when available.
Wraps string in single quotes and escapes existing quotes.

input
String to sanitize
Shell-safe string
input
Input parameter.
Return value.
Implements sanitizeForShell without additional internal calls.

briefdescription.para: Sanitizes string for safe display in JSON.

detaileddescription.para: Sanitize For Json.

Escapes:
Backslash → \
Newline →
Tab → \t
Quote → "
Control characters → \uXXXX

input
String to sanitize
JSON-safe string
input
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: reserve(), size(), snprintf().

briefdescription.para: Validates identifier (table/column/database name).

detaileddescription.para: Validate Identifier.
Uses strict whitelist: [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]* Maximum length: 128 characters

identifier
Name to validate
ValidationResult
identifier
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), size(), std::to_string(), isalpha(), isalnum(), std::string().

briefdescription.para: Validates configuration file path.

detaileddescription.para: Validate Config Path.

Checks:
Must be absolute or relative to safe directory
No path traversal (../, ..)
Must end in allowed extension
Must exist and be readable

path
Path to validate
allowed_extension
Allowed file extension (e.g., ".conf")
ValidationResult
path
Input parameter.
allowed_extension
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: validatePathTraversal(), empty(), find(), std::string().
